name: kemolate
description: Work on your Kemolate comic translation chapters: read pages with Kemolate's own OCR, check and correct the reading, translate and file it.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Kemolate desktop app running on this computer. Kemolate must be open, with its MCP server turned on in Settings › Agents. Pages stay on this computer: images come from the chapter open in the Kemolate window, as reduced-size renditions, only when a tool asks for one.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port shown in Kemolate › Settings › Agents. Change it only if you changed it there.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The playbook for working in Kemolate, read before a multi-step job.

tools.name: get_active_workspace
tools.description: The chapter and page open in the Kemolate window right now.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the comic chapters, most recently touched first.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: A chapter's languages, reading direction and translator's note.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: A chapter's pages in reading order, and how far each has got.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Every text block on some pages, with its source and translations.

tools.name: request_page_read
tools.description: Read pages with Kemolate's own OCR, in the open chapter.

tools.name: review_page_reading
tools.description: Each block's reading beside a close crop of it, to check.

tools.name: get_page_image
tools.description: A page, or a region of it, as a reduced-size image.

tools.name: correct_blocks
tools.description: Fix what a reading got wrong, one block at a time.

tools.name: save_page_blocks
tools.description: File text blocks read off a page.

tools.name: sort_page_blocks
tools.description: Put a page's blocks into reading order.

tools.name: prepare_page_translation
tools.description: The translation job for some pages, as Kemolate would prompt it.

tools.name: save_page_translations
tools.description: File translations, and what the pages taught the glossary and cast.

tools.name: set_lettering_style
tools.description: How lines are lettered: face, size, weight, placement, ink, shape.

tools.name: review_lettering
tools.description: How each line on a page is lettered, with flags and lettered close-ups.

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: The terms a chapter has settled on in one language.

tools.name: get_cast
tools.description: The characters a chapter knows about.
